subject: reasoning
question: Anil starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 2 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point F. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90- degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Anil starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards the south.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 2 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km.
 
• He takes a final left turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point F
